description: 港湾台帳 固定式及び軌道走行式 [railways and stations and ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 県内の港湾施設のリスト（固定式及び軌道走行式）. Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2024-05-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
